## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behaviour. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Validation

Describe checks and results. For firmware changes, include board-core and library versions, hardware, host OS, and keyboard layout. State explicitly if hardware testing was unavailable.

## Documentation and compatibility

Explain changes to wiring, controls, saved settings, or host compatibility.

- [ ] The change is focused and its scope is explained.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and the Unreleased changelog entry are updated.
- [ ] Validation results and remaining limitations are recorded.
